description: Legacy organization resource-cap management only; this tool does not purchase Dock's per-person plans. Read get_billing for current billing. If the org has no card on file, returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the human. A live change with a card is consent-gated: chat mode returns a confirm_token to present and repeat within 60 seconds; web mode returns an approval_url and polling_url. Agent callers always require the org owner's web approval for a change, including cancelling a scheduled downgrade. Never present these legacy resource tiers as an allowance upgrade.

confirm_token.description: Chat-mode only. The token returned by the first call as `confirm_token`. Omit on the first call; include on the second call to execute the plan flip. Single-use, 60s TTL, bound to {org, caller, operation, params}.

mode.description: Consent surface. 'chat' (default) uses the in-chat confirm_token round-trip. 'web' returns an approval_url the user clicks in a browser. Use 'web' if you're headless or your user prefers a click-to-approve flow.

plan.description: Legacy resource-cap tier identifier; defaults to the first enum value. This does not buy a per-person plan.

name: upgrade_plan
